title: Add ProjectionSnapshot contract with source hashes
purpose: Create a deterministic render input for the full-screen console while preventing render cache from becoming authority.
scope: Define ProjectionSnapshot fields for runs, audit, approvals, recovery, support, ecosystem and release evidence.
Attach source hashes or freshness markers for each projection source.
Represent degraded, missing or stale sources explicitly.
Ensure ProjectionSnapshot is immutable render input.
Add tests proving refresh rebuilds from durable sources.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectionSnapshot is not used as durable source of truth.
Source hashes are deterministic for unchanged inputs.
Missing or degraded sources are visible to the operator.
Refresh cannot mask approval, recovery or rollback state.
failure_modes: Degraded source is hidden by dashboard health.
